title: The announcement
text:
After our dinners with operators in Sacramento and Manhattan Beach, we're bringing the conversation to Fresno.

On Wednesday, Nov. 18, I'm hosting a private dinner for Fresno-area real estate operators: wholesalers, flippers and acquisition teams working out how to keep deal flow strong while margins get tighter.

Good food and an honest conversation about where the market is heading and what's working right now.

Time and venue to be announced soon. Save the date, and if you'd like an invitation, comment or send me a note.

title: Harder market
text:
Finding deals is harder. Margins are tighter. The operators who win this cycle are the ones with better systems.

Sundae co-founder and CEO Josh Stech is hosting a private dinner for Fresno-area real estate operators on Wednesday, Nov. 18: market trends, where the industry is heading and how to build a stronger acquisition business in a harder market.

Time and venue to be announced. Get the details first.

title: Meet your host
text:
Meet your host for Fresno.

Josh Stech is co-founder and CEO of Sundae. Before Sundae, Josh was founding partner and senior vice president of sales at LendingHome, and co-founder and CFO of Purpose Built Investments, executing 1,200+ transactions buying, renovating and selling houses.

On Wednesday, Nov. 18, Josh sits down with Fresno-area operators for dinner and an open conversation about the market. Time and venue to be announced.

title: Let's talk in Fresno
text:
The market has changed. The opportunity has not.

If you run acquisitions in the Central Valley, join Josh Stech, Sundae co-founder and CEO, and fellow operators for a private dinner in Fresno on Wednesday, Nov. 18.

Time and venue to be announced. Leave your details and you'll hear first.

title: Who this dinner is for
text:
Who the Fresno dinner is for:

• Wholesalers closing deals every month
• Fix-and-flip operators
• Acquisition-led investors and team leads
• Operators ready to scale in the next six to 12 months

If that's you, or someone you respect, I'd like you at the table on Wednesday, Nov. 18. Time and venue to be announced soon.

title: What we'll cover
text:
What's on the table in Fresno on Wednesday, Nov. 18:

1. Market trends: what the data says about acquisitions right now
2. Where the industry is heading: lead costs, conversion, dispositions and capital
3. How to build a stronger acquisition business in a harder market, straight from operators

Then dinner and conversation. Time and venue to be announced.

title: The market has changed
text:
Deals are harder to find. Margins are tighter.

The opportunity is still there for teams with better systems. That's the conversation I want to have with Fresno-area operators over dinner on Wednesday, Nov. 18.

Time and venue to be announced. (The photo is from our Sacramento dinner in September.)
